Numerator of fx=sin⁡x+sin⁡3x+2sin⁡3x+sin⁡5x+3sin⁡5x+sin⁡7x
=2cos⁡xsin⁡2x+2sin⁡4x+3sin⁡6x
Hence, fx=2cos⁡x, if fx1=2cos⁡x1 & fx2=2sin⁡x1
